subject.title: feat(skills-mcp): implement skills MCP bridge with configuration and handler

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a new environment-configured gateway skills MCP endpoint with dedicated bearer auth, uploads, and process-local job handles?
rationale: The branch creates a new externally callable gateway execution surface, so automation cannot decide the product and security boundary even after mechanical blockers are fixed.

options.title: Repair And Prove Core Bridge
options.body: Fix the route, type, lint, docs, auth/rate-limit, and proof gaps, then reconsider the core bridge with maintainer security review.

options.title: Move Out Of Core
options.body: Rework the idea as a plugin, ClawHub package, or missing core API proposal if the endpoint is optional integration surface rather than core gateway behavior.

options.title: Accept Boundary Deliberately
options.body: Keep the dedicated bearer endpoint only after explicitly accepting the upload, job, operator configuration, and availability contracts.

recommendation.title: Repair And Prove Core Bridge
recommendation.body: Fix the route, type, lint, docs, auth/rate-limit, and proof gaps, then reconsider the core bridge with maintainer security review.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history ties this choice most directly to MCP loopback transport and gateway Control UI routing decisions.
